units.source_text: 明石皇后回宫时，顾念父亲孤居，特将三皇子留在这里，以慰寂寥。

en.t: When Empress Akashi returned to the palace, she thought of her father living alone and deliberately left the Third Prince here to ease his loneliness.

units.source_text: 三皇子特别留心保护庭前那株红梅树，说是“外婆吩咐我的”。

en.t: The Third Prince took special care to protect the red plum tree in front of the garden, saying, "Grandmother told me to."
Genji saw this and was deeply saddened.
When February came, flowers of every kind were in full bloom.

units.source_text: 含苞未放的花木，枝头也都呈现一片云霞似的。

en.t: Even the flowering trees and shrubs whose buds had not yet opened made their branch tips look like a mass of clouds and rosy mist.

units.source_text: 黄莺在已成紫夫人遗念的红梅树上，嘹亮地啁啾鸣啭。

en.t: A bush warbler perched in the red plum tree, now a remembrance of Lady Murasaki, and sang in bright, clear notes.

units.source_text: 源氏便走出去看，独自吟道：

en.t: Genji then went outside to look at it and recited softly to himself:
